question: Should ClawHub adopt duplicate-case rejection for skill packages now, including `PROTOCOL.md` collision enforcement, once this branch is rebased?
rationale: The implementation shape is coherent, but the change deliberately alters accepted package inputs and extends enforcement to a package-file scope that is not fully documented in the current skill format contract.

options.title: Rebase and adopt the policy
options.body: Confirm the compatibility-preserving collision rule, preserve current staged publish behavior during rebase, and continue normal merge review.

options.title: Narrow to readme collisions
options.body: Ask for enforcement only around `SKILL.md`/`skill.md`/`skills.md` until `PROTOCOL.md` is explicitly documented as part of the ClawHub package contract.

options.title: Defer enforcement
options.body: Keep the linked issue as the policy tracker until maintainers define the migration, docs, and content-cleanup plan.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt the policy
recommendation.body: Confirm the compatibility-preserving collision rule, preserve current staged publish behavior during rebase, and continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is tied to the current docs/publish validation lines and the post-base staged publish work that must be preserved.
